nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Rinse {@moong} and soak in water overnight (minimum 6 hrs)
Blend and refrigerate batter — takes 5 min; set toddler portion aside before adding chili

method.title: Make batter (night before)
items: Blend with {@water:blend} until smooth — should coat a spoon but pour easily
Fold in {@spinach}, {@capsicum}, {@paneer:main} and {@coriander} by hand — do not blend

method.label: Toddler — set aside now (night before)
items: Remove ⅓ cup of batter before adding green chili
Stir in {@turmeric:toddler} and {@hing:toddler} — skip green chili only
Optionally stir in crumbled {@paneer:toddler} for extra protein

method.title: Cook (morning)
items: Stir batter well — add {@water:adjust} if too thick
Heat tawa on medium; grease with {@ghee:grease}
Pour {=~¼ cup} and spread in a circle; cook 2–3 min until edges lift
Drizzle {@ghee:drizzle} around edges, flip, cook 1–2 min more
Cook toddler batter on medium-low first — smaller chillas, serve flat

method.label: Toddler cooking
items: Cook on medium-low; make 2 small chillas {2–3 tbsp batter each}
Press gently with spatula — no aggressive flipping
Serve with plain yogurt or mild coriander chutney

method.label: Tip
method.text: If chillas tear, the tawa isn't hot enough — wait 30 seconds before spreading.
